vocabulary.meaning_en: a new word made by joining parts of two words
vocabulary.example: 'Brunch' is a portmanteau word: breakfast + lunch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put something online for others to see
vocabulary.example: She shares photos of her garden every week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the job of looking after your children
to move up or down on a screen
vocabulary.example: He scrolled through the news on his phone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a terrible, bad future or ending
vocabulary.example: The news was full of doom and gloom.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a very strong fear of something
vocabulary.example: She has a phobia of spiders.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to use something again or make it into something new

vocabulary.example: They gave me the old chair for free.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a mobile phone that works like a small computer
in stories, a dead person who walks; a person who moves without thinking
vocabulary.example: I was so tired I walked around like a zombie.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person walking in the street

vocabulary.example: We went on vacation to the coast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not thinking you are better than others
vocabulary.example: He is very humble about his success.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to talk proudly about yourself to impress people
vocabulary.example: Stop bragging about your new phone!

vocabulary.meaning_en: websites and apps for sharing posts with people
vocabulary.example: I spend too much time on social media.

fine_lines.title: Smartphone vs dumbphone
fine_lines.explanation_ar: smartphone هاتف ذكي فيه تطبيقات وإنترنت. dumbphone هاتف بسيط للمكالمات والرسائل فقط، ويختاره بعض الناس ليقللوا وقتهم على الشاشة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A smartphone has apps and the internet. A dumbphone is a simple phone just for calls and texts; some people choose one to spend less time on screens.

examples.sentence: I check my email on my smartphone.
He bought a dumbphone so he can focus on his studies.

fine_lines.title: Brag vs humblebrag
fine_lines.explanation_ar: brag تفاخر واضح. أما humblebrag فتفاخر مخفي في كلام يبدو متواضعاً أو شكوى صغيرة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: To brag is to show off openly. A humblebrag hides the showing off inside words that sound modest or like a small complaint.

examples.sentence: He keeps bragging that he is the best player.
'I'm so tired of winning prizes' is a humblebrag.

fine_lines.title: Recycle vs freecycle
fine_lines.explanation_ar: recycle تعني إعادة تصنيع المواد مثل الورق والبلاستيك. freecycle تعني أن تعطي أغراضك القديمة لشخص آخر مجاناً بدل رميها.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Recycle = turn materials into something new. Freecycle = give your old things to someone else for free instead of throwing them away.

examples.sentence: I freecycled my old desk to a student.

expressions.meaning_ar: الإفراط في نشر صور الأبناء على الإنترنت
expressions.meaning_en: parents sharing too many photos and videos of their children online (share + parenting)
expressions.example: Think about your child's privacy before sharenting.

expressions.meaning_en: spending too long reading bad news on a screen (doom + scrolling)
expressions.example: I was doomscrolling until midnight and couldn't sleep.

expressions.meaning_en: the fear of being without your mobile phone (no + mobile + phobia)
expressions.example: He can't leave his phone for a minute - he has nomophobia.

expressions.meaning_en: to give away things you don't need for free so they are used again (free + recycle)
expressions.example: We freecycled our old toys to a family nearby.

expressions.meaning_en: a simple mobile phone with no apps, just calls and texts (dumb + phone)
expressions.example: My dumbphone battery lasts a whole week.

expressions.meaning_en: a person who walks while looking at their phone and doesn't notice what's around them (smartphone + zombie)
expressions.example: A smombie walked straight into me in the station.

expressions.meaning_en: a holiday where you also do some work (work + vacation)
expressions.example: She took a workation by the sea and worked from her hotel.

expressions.meaning_en: showing off while pretending to be modest or to complain (humble + brag)
expressions.example: 'My new car is too big for my garage' - what a humblebrag!

grammar.title: How portmanteau words are made
grammar.explanation_ar: الكلمة المنحوتة تُصنع بأخذ بداية كلمة ونهاية كلمة أخرى ودمجهما: sm(artphone) + (z)ombie = smombie. ومعناها يجمع معنى الكلمتين. كثير من هذه الكلمات غير رسمية وحديثة.
grammar.explanation_en: A portmanteau word joins the start of one word with the end of another: sm(artphone) + (z)ombie = smombie. Its meaning mixes both words. Many are new and informal.

questions.question: Which two words make 'workation'?
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة workation مكوّنة من work + vacation.

questions.question: A person who walks along staring at their phone is a ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة smombie مكوّنة من smartphone + zombie.
questions.explanation_en: A smombie walks while looking at a phone.

questions.question: 'Nomophobia' is:
choices: a fear of being without your phone
questions.explanation_ar: nomophobia = الخوف من البقاء بلا هاتف.
questions.explanation_en: It is the fear of being without your mobile phone.

questions.question: Reading bad news online for hours is called ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: doomscrolling = تصفّح الأخبار السيئة بلا توقّف.
questions.explanation_en: Doomscrolling = reading bad news for too long.

questions.question: 'I'm so busy because everyone wants to hire me.' This is a ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: تفاخر مخفي في شكل شكوى = humblebrag.
questions.explanation_en: Showing off while sounding like a complaint = humblebrag.

questions.question: I didn't need my old bike, so I ___ it to my neighbour.
questions.explanation_ar: freecycle = أعطاه مجاناً ليُستعمل من جديد.
questions.explanation_en: Freecycle = give it away for free.

questions.question: What is the difference between 'brag' and 'humblebrag'?
choices: Brag is hidden, humblebrag is open
Humblebrag hides the showing off in modest words
Humblebrag means to be really humble
questions.explanation_ar: humblebrag تفاخر مخفي، أما brag فتفاخر واضح.
questions.explanation_en: A humblebrag hides the showing off; bragging is open.

questions.question: Parents who post too many photos of their kids are ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة sharenting مكوّنة من share + parenting.

questions.question: Which phone has NO apps?
questions.explanation_ar: dumbphone هاتف بسيط للمكالمات والرسائل فقط.
questions.explanation_en: A dumbphone is only for calls and texts.

questions.question: A 'portmanteau word' is:
choices: a word joined from two words
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة المنحوتة تُصنع من دمج كلمتين.
questions.explanation_en: It is made by joining two words.
